data.short_description: A new restaurant from owner Will "Willie" Chapman is preparing to open in the former Sammy's Grill space on Highland Road. Sammy's Grill recently closed after serving the community for more than four decades. The 8,300-square-foot space is being taken over by The Historic Highland Road Grill.

Representatives from both Eataly and Tysons Corner Center have declined to officially confirm the new location.

data.location: 1961 Chain Bridge Rd Space N10L, McLean, VA 22102

The concept promises "kitchen, cocktails, nightlife" targeting guests aged 30 to 60, with live music and dishes inspired by Chicago and New Orleans. A certificate of occupancy is currently under review with the Memphis and Shelby County Division of Planning and Development.

Oceans & Earth, the Yorba Linda organic and gluten-free restaurant founded by Chef Adam Navidi, is preparing to open a new location at The MET office campus in Costa Mesa. The property and business have returned to family hands after 15 to 16 years under outside management. A specific opening date has not been set.

Bruiser's "The Hot Dog Place" is preparing to open a new location in Covington with construction currently underway. The team is targeting a summer opening and has been sharing progress updates on the company's website and Facebook page. The restaurant, owned by Kevin and Melissa Barduca, is known for its loaded hot dogs and sausage menu.

Gather Cafe and Supper Club, the reservation-only multi-course dining concept founded by chef Sarah Fragoso, is preparing to open at 196 Cohasset Road, Suite 150, in Chico's Garden Villa commercial center. An opening date for the new location has not yet been announced.

Air Café is an upscale French-American fine dining restaurant planned for the Hotel des Artistes building in the Upper West Side. It will replace The Leopard at des Artistes and follow a similar style of service, retaining the famed Howard Chandler Christy murals. Managing partner Max Katzenberg and partner Ariel Arce, who also operate Tokyo Record Bar and Roscioli in Lower Manhattan, are behind the concept.

Owner Jonathan Vargas will serve sub sandwiches, pizza, hot dogs, and other foods, with signature sandwiches including The Pit Stop, the General Managers Special, and the F-250. Ross Dress for Less is a national off-price retail chain known for discounted apparel and home goods. A proposed location in Lakeside at 9532 Winter Gardens Boulevard would take over a former Rite Aid space, with the project currently pending consults. The company currently operates numerous locations throughout San Diego County.

DD's Discounts is a subsidiary brand of Ross Stores focused on budget-oriented apparel and home goods. Ross has filed plans for a DD's Discounts store at 1854 Coronado Avenue, which will replace a former Rite Aid location, with the project currently pending consults. The addition would further extend the company's reach in lower-price-point retail categories across San Diego.

data.location: 406 W Belt Line Rd, Cedar Hill, TX 75104
data.short_description: Mija Barbecue is a family-owned barbecue restaurant in Cedar Hill, Texas, that began as a backyard barbecue project before becoming a brick-and-mortar business. The owners announced the closure via social media, with the restaurant set to close on June 27, 2026, without providing a specific reason. The restaurant moved into its brick-and-mortar home in 2024, transforming a historic 1938 house.

Crackin Blue Crabs is an upcoming food truck promising "All Flavor No Flex" serving fried and grilled food. What Now came across plan review paperwork submitted by Crackin Blue Crabs LLC, though no opening timeline or location has been confirmed. Co-owner Latasha Armstrong was not immediately available for comment when reached on Friday.

Sheep is a new rooftop dining concept planned by Id Est Hospitality Group founder Kelly Whitaker, also co-owner of The Wolf's Tailor. It will open on the sixth-floor rooftop of the Clayton Hotel & Members Club at 233 Clayton Street in Cherry Creek, as a three-month residency from July to October. Guests can expect a nightly four-course menu with multiple choices designed by Whitaker and chef Taylor Stark.

McDonald's is a global fast food chain opening a new location in Magog on Rue Sherbrooke, across from Walmart. The new restaurant is expected to open in October 2026, overseen by franchise owner Caroline Iannuzzi who currently operates seven existing McDonald's restaurants across the Estrie region. Construction is already underway on the vacant site.

Gringos Tacos is an upcoming food truck serving Flagler County, offering birria tacos and ramen. Signs point to launching soon after What Now came across plan review paperwork submitted by Dos Bros Foods LLC. Chef Chris Gibbs was not immediately available for comment when reached on Thursday.

Planet Fitness is a nationwide fitness center chain known for affordable memberships and a beginner-friendly environment. It has opened a new 21,141-square-foot gym at 3066 228th Avenue SE in Sammamish, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony scheduled for June 18, 2026, at 2 p.m. The location is the brand's 19th in the Seattle-Tacoma area, operated by CDM Fitness Holdings.

Palazzo Pizza Italiana is a pizza restaurant headed up by Jason Fox and the team at Josephine's Italian Market. It will open at 214 E Cass St in downtown Tampa, with renderings showing a moody interior with a room-length bar and large semi-circular booths. A previous instantiation of Palazzo Pizza was located on West Platt Street and was active until May 2024.
